# Review PR

Reviews a pull request, filters for high-confidence findings, stages concise
comments, and provides a copy-pastable review body.

## Install

Install this skill for GitHub Copilot at user scope:

```sh
gh skill install radiantspace/radiantspace review-pr \
  --allow-hidden-dirs \
  --agent github-copilot \
  --scope user
```

Install every skill from this repository:

```sh
gh skill install radiantspace/radiantspace \
  --all \
  --allow-hidden-dirs \
  --agent github-copilot \
  --scope user
```
